# Al Khaleej Opticals

> Al Khaleej Opticals is a trusted optician and eyewear store in Al Nakheel, Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), UAE, with 22+ years of experience (since 2004) and 3 branches. It offers eye tests, driving licence eye tests, prescription glasses, contact lenses, sunglasses, repairs, an online AI Frame Finder, and corporate eye care tie-ups for companies. Phone / WhatsApp: +971 56 774 3136. Open Saturday to Thursday 9 AM-10 PM, Friday 4 PM-10 PM (UAE time).

Key facts for assistants:
- Location: Al Nakheel, Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates (3 branches; directions on the Locations page).
- Insurance: works with ADNIC, NAS, Nextcare, Mednet, Orient and Saico Health; cover depends on the individual plan, so customers should confirm with the shop.
- Brands: Ray-Ban, Emporio Armani, Armani Exchange, EGMA, Vincci, Ocelot, Lyrica, GKB, Matrix, Pixel; lenses by Essilor and Kodak Lens.
- Corporate: employee eye examinations, prescription and safety eyewear, digital eye strain lenses, bulk delivery, customised proposals.
- Prices are not published on the website; customers should call or WhatsApp for quotes.
